genuineCaptureBoundary.selectedFirstProfile: Public pure context/projection exports with authored v3 entries and explicit leaf IDs; invoke no SessionManager constructors, migrations, file IO, random IDs or clocks

genuineCaptureBoundary.sourceWholeModuleRule: Load unchanged entire module; no private-function extraction, import erasure, child-process shim or replacement loader

qualificationRequirements: Before and after setup verify clean exact upstream HEAD and all 2093 canonical source files, acquired checkout conversions, runtime/npm and reused accepted archive bytes.
Acquire exact six registry tarballs only in explicit reviewed --restore; verify SRI and tar names, types, confinement, no native addon/install lifecycle or unexpected dependencies.
Inspect packaged root license evidence (MIT/ISC); preserve dependency declarations and lock entry identity. Registry signatures/attestations remain separate open checks.
Use npm11.6.2 ci with ignore-scripts, bin links/optional peers/audit/fund disabled, explicit owned prefix/cache/config and scrubbed environment.
Require exactly eight installed package directories, full archive-byte equality, unchanged root projected lock/manifest and matching hidden npm lock; preserve partial or uncertain writes on failure.
After successful restore prove genuine unchanged whole session module load; report any further missing dependency instead of installing automatically or substituting source.
Freeze only subsequently observed context outputs, source/dependency loaded closure, deterministic repeatability and authored-versus-observed provenance.

approval.setupPreparationScope: Root reviews this new three-file plan/helper/doc; root invokes local --prepare after freeze.
approval.networkRestoreScope: Root submits the concrete exact-package --restore command to applicable executor require_escalated auto-review; this helper has not performed downloads or installation.
approval.executorRejectionRule: Do not bypass a rejection; report exact action/reason and leave the original qualified oracles unchanged.

limitations: The prior two- and three-package source-only load probes both failed at eager cross-spawn import; no genuine full-session context observations currently exist.
Eight packages are the exact static required profile, not proof the whole module now loads or all session APIs work.
Pure export qualification does not establish persistence, migration, compaction generation, file IO or session runtime behavior.
Upstream pure helpers have malformed graph/leaf fallback and content-repair behavior; native stricter admission differences must be disclosed.
No accepted oracle, old lock/golden, source module or dependency installation is modified by this proposal.
